intermediate_validation.reason: Synthetic transfer fixture allowed an exact 15-minute connection; changed its walk to 16. Error classification distinguishes timed transfers inside the horizon.
Ruff removed an unreferenced imported fixture; made its re-export explicit. These were fixture registration errors, not a successful GUI run.
Existing Windows GUI pytest protocol leaves previous collector setup active when mixing GUI and non-GUI modules. Separate documented commands completed without errors; runner unchanged.

actual Tk dashboard action and controls
selected itinerary checked against active exact stop_times rows
synthetic_demonstration.gui: Two real Windows Tk tests, isolated processes, no mocks replacing windows. Network blocked by autouse fixture.

real_exercise.source: existing official local static catalog and two actual configured profiles; no synthetic fallback
real_exercise.outcome: No real itinerary recommendation: explicit final-leg arrivals within the search do not meet the configured work deadline including walk and margin; the return profile has no saved departure. No personal clock was invented.
real_exercise.private_reproduction: From project root with PYTHONPATH=src, python data/pilots/static-planning-20261114/exercise.py (requires existing personal data; refuses to overwrite real-results.json; choose a new private directory to repeat).
real_exercise.public_privacy: No personal IDs, routes, stops, locations, clocks or profile payloads. Private database fingerprints are not published.

bounds.work_search: max(civil midnight, deadline-window) through deadline; home departure on selected civil date; first ready time adds initial walk
bounds.return_search: explicit or saved departure through departure+window; final arrival may be later
bounds.transfers: all boardings within the single global horizon and after configured walking+buffer; spatial connectivity unverified
bounds.diagnostic_probe: at most one additional 1440-minute per-leg query on a missing leg; not included in optimization
bounds.frequencies: exact_times=1 enumerated; exact_times=0 excluded from point recommendations
bounds.safety: only the configured margin; shown separately from scheduled arrival plus final walk

limitations: Scheduled times do not verify real arrivals, availability or punctuality.
Optimization covers explicit times only inside the documented bounded horizon.
Transfers preserve user minutes; no spatial connection is assumed.
A valid static service date does not certify operational freshness.
delivery: Prepared for QA Check; no commit or push. Further capabilities/captures require explicit authorization.
